subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should Talk gateway relays intentionally stop accepting noncanonical base64 forms tolerated by Node's permissive decoder while retaining standard and URL-safe alphabets?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sound, but source inspection cannot determine whether any deployed client intentionally depends on permissive decoding; accepting that upgrade-visible boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve strict relay validation
options.body: Land the shared decoder and accept explicit RPC failures for malformed or noncanonical frames while retaining standard and base64url clients.

options.title: Preserve a named legacy form
options.body: Identify any legitimate additional encoding form, normalize only that form explicitly, and add compatibility proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve strict relay validation
recommendation.body: Land the shared decoder and accept explicit RPC failures for malformed or noncanonical frames while retaining standard and base64url clients.

likelyOwner.reason: This person was directly routed into the Talk gateway review discussion and is the strongest available owner signal for the compatibility choice.
